title: Vegawon’s Legacy Devlog #2 – November 2024
shortDescription: In November, we had an intense and productive working period for Vegawon's Legacy. We strengthened our technical infrastructure and introduced many innovations.
fullBody: Dear Vegawon’s Legacy fans, In November, we had an intense and productive working period. Here are the important developments: Land of the Crescent: Steam Festival We updated our Steam page for the Games from Turkey Steam Festival, adding new cover images and screenshots. More Modular AI System We implemented a new modular AI system. This allows all enemies to be derived from a single base class, speeding up development. New Injured System When health falls below 20%, the character enters an injured state: • 30% reduction in movement speed. • Unique animations depicting injury. First Boss: The Dark Knight We’re excited to unveil the first boss: • Battle unfolds across three distinct phases. • Unique behavior trees in each phase. Physics & Optimization • More fluid gameplay with reduced glitches. • No more sliding enemies. Thank you for your continued support! The DWS Interactive Team
